Subject: Request: compute stipend + trial extension for rural health NLP pilot

Hi Mina,

Thanks for connecting earlier this week. I'm Sara, Community Programs Lead at Health Bridges. We're running a small pilot that applies an NLP pipeline to triage and anonymize patient support messages from three rural clinics in the Midwest. The project is non-commercial and IRB-approved (deidentified text only).

We signed up for Redwood's trial last month and used the initial credits quickly while experimenting with models and prompt tuning. We're now at a point where a modest extension would let us run the full 6-week evaluation across all three sites and produce an impact report for our funders.

Ask: would Redwood consider a one-time compute stipend (roughly 50k inference tokens worth of credits) or a 60-day trial extension for Health Bridges? If helpful, attached is a one-pager with scope and timelines.

Quick details:
- Pilot duration: May–June 2028 (6 weeks evaluation)
- Data: de-identified patient messages; no PHI in the dataset
- Deliverable: anonymization model + triage dashboard + final report for funders

Appreciate any guidance on the best route (trial extension vs. promo credits). Happy to set a 30-minute call if that helps.

Thanks,
Sara Klein
Community Programs Lead
Health Bridges Community Research
Attachment: healthbridges_project_one_pager.pdf (PDF, 210 KB)

Mina — quick tech note after skimming the one-pager and the sample logs Sara shared via the Drive link:

- Workload: mostly short patient messages (~20–60 tokens per message) with occasional longer notes (~250 tokens). Expect batch inference for nightly runs + interactive preview for clinicians.
- Estimate: 3 sites x 1,500 messages/week ≈ 4,500 messages/week. At median 40 tokens per inference that’s ~180k tokens/week for full-run testing. If they only run sampling and validation passes, a 50k token stipend gets them through parameter tuning plus a couple of full passes.
- Recommendation: Offer a 60-day trial extension and a 50k promo credit. That combination lets them continue iterative tuning and finish the evaluation without immediate procurement.

Constraints/remarks:
- De-identified data is fine but we require a signed DPA for any extended trial that accesses customer data in our private routing (standard ask).
- If they need sustained throughput > 200k tokens/week we should discuss a dedicated pilot bucket (reserved capacity) and an SOW.

Happy to join a call to walk through integration notes.

— Dev
Principal Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
